station_set.selection_reason: existing fixed validation-station semantics; fixed before outcomes

visibility_and_pass_selection.coarse_pass_rule: maximal consecutive above-threshold scan samples with gaps <=30 s
visibility_and_pass_selection.refinement_rule: refine the run containing the coarse maximum over coarse bounds expanded by 60 s; choose the earliest timestamp on an exact maximum tie
visibility_and_pass_selection.pass_quota_rule: classify each eligible pass by causal ordinary-GP element age at its refined peak; within each satellite x month x freshness bin retain the first two chronological eligible passes
visibility_and_pass_selection.pass_selection_fallback_rule: if a chronological candidate fails a predeclared availability, propagation, visibility, or segment-validity exclusion, continue to the next chronological pass in the same satellite x month x freshness bin until two passes are retained or candidates are exhausted

segment_selection.center_rule: centers are max(pass_start+30 s, pass_start+0.25*duration), refined public-predicted elevation peak, and min(pass_end-30 s, pass_start+0.75*duration), rounded to the nearest integer UTC second with half-to-even disabled and 0.5 s rounded upward
segment_selection.duplicate_center_rule: within a pass keep phase order RISING_25_PERCENT, PEAK, SETTING_75_PERCENT and drop later duplicate centers
segment_selection.segment_visibility_requirement: all 61 public-predicted samples from the fixed segment-center causal ordinary GP must have elevation_deg >=10.0

ordinary_gp.causal_selection: CREATION_DATE <= evaluation_time; latest CREATION_DATE, then latest EPOCH, then lexicographically latest GP_ID
ordinary_gp.segment_propagation: select once at segment center and propagate that fixed ordinary GP to all 61 segment timestamps

reference.semantics: SpaceX-E/SupGP higher-quality historical reference; not ground truth, true orbit, or exact state
reference.selection_rule: for each segment center select the same-satellite SupGP OMM row minimizing absolute EPOCH-to-center separation; on a tie prefer the earlier EPOCH, then the lower source row index
reference.interpolation_rule: no state interpolation; initialize the selected SupGP OMM with sgp4.omm.initialize and propagate that fixed representation to all 61 segment timestamps

freshness.outside_support: age<=0 or age>36 h => OUT_OF_SUPPORT and excluded from formal aggregate

doppler.same_inputs_requirement: same satellite, timestamps, station, carrier, Doppler implementation for public and reference

ols_and_score.parameter_semantics: delta_b_orbit and delta_k_orbit are incremental shifts, not complete production b_hat/k_hat
ols_and_score.zero_energy_rule: if raw_energy_hz2 <= 1e-24, set projection_residual_ratio=0, explained_fraction=1, and energy_status=NUMERIC_ZERO

diagnostics.curvature: fit centered quadratic [1,x,x^2]; curvature_gain_fraction=1-SSE_quadratic/SSE_linear; if SSE_linear<=1e-24 set gain=0
diagnostics.geometry_effect_rule: GEOMETRY_EFFECT_NONNEGLIGIBLE if, in at least two freshness bins with n>=20, at least one outcome among raw_rms_hz, score_orbit_hz, abs_delta_k_orbit_hz_per_s has max/min eligible elevation-or-phase group median ratio>=2 and absolute group-median range>=the pooled median of that outcome; eligible groups require n>=5
diagnostics.freshness_structure_replication_rule: report, without threshold modification, whether exploratory and June Spearman signs agree and whether absolute rho>=0.3 with p<0.01 in each split; also inspect bin medians and quantiles

aggregation.primary_unit: satellite x month x pass_id x phase_label x station_id
aggregation.primary_weighting: one segment unit receives one weight
aggregation.coverage_output: satellite x month x freshness_bin before numerical Doppler science

population_selection_allowed_variables: causal ordinary GP identity and element age
SupGP reference record availability and epoch separation
exclusion_rules: satellite absent from frozen cohort or monthly raw source
no causal ordinary GP at pass or segment center
selected ordinary GP CREATION_DATE after center
no same-satellite SupGP row within 3 h of segment center
coarse/refined public visibility run not recoverable
any of 61 segment samples below 10 deg under the fixed segment-center causal ordinary GP
segment does not contain exactly 61 one-second samples
ordinary or reference SGP4 propagation error/nonfinite state
duplicate segment center within a pass after fixed phase ordering
execution_order: build population and freshness coverage using allowed variables only
freeze population CSV SHA and coverage SHA
without changing protocol/population/methods run June confirmatory numerical science
write combined summaries/report without modifying existing frozen outputs
